draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Yana! Just outside the village rise two huge karst outcrops, Bhairaveshwara Shikhara and Mohini Shikhara, now a National Geological Monument.
draft.hungryLine: My notes don't list any eateries in this little village, so carry water and snacks for your visit to the rocks.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The rocks at Yana are about a 23 min walk from here, on the outskirts of the village.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take your time around the base of the rocks. It's a village, so the pace here is slow.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Yana's rocks are karst formations, and the Geological Survey of India declared the site a National Geological Monument.

spots.name: Yana
spots.detail: 23 min walk · Two giant karst rock outcrops

tips.title: Dress modestly at the temple.
tips.body: There's a temple to Bhairaveshwara, a form of Shiva, at the site.

tips.title: Bring water and good shoes.
tips.body: The rocks are on the outskirts of the village, about a 23 min walk away.

story.title: Rocks of karst
story.body: Several karst formations rose in this region, and the two biggest stand on the edge of the village.

story.title: A temple to Shiva
story.body: A temple at Yana is dedicated to Bhairaveshwara, a form of Shiva, and one of the outcrops is named after him.

story.title: A national monument
story.body: The Geological Survey of India declared Yana a National Geological Monument in 2026.
